fields.Name: Community: Visible Forums
fields.Description: Limits Forum rows to those reachable by the current user via fnCommunityForumAccess.
fields.FilterText: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommunity].[fnCommunityForumAccess]('{{UserID}}') AS fa WHERE fa.ForumID = [ID])

fields.Name: Community: Visible Forum Posts
fields.Description: Limits ForumPost rows to reachable forums, enforcing Team band visibility and moderation queue visibility.
fields.FilterText: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommunity].[fnCommunityForumAccess]('{{UserID}}') AS fa WHERE fa.ForumID = [ForumID] AND ([VisibilityBand] = N'Shared' OR ([VisibilityBand] = N'Team' AND fa.CanSeeTeam = 1)) AND ([Status] IN (N'Published', N'Answered', N'Resolved', N'Archived') OR [AuthorUserID] = '{{UserID}}' OR fa.CanModerate = 1))

fields.Name: Community: Visible Forum Post Children
fields.Description: Limits child rows of ForumPost (tags, reactions, attachments) to those whose parent post is visible.
fields.FilterText: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommunity].[ForumPost] AS fp INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCommunity].[fnCommunityForumAccess]('{{UserID}}') AS fa ON fa.ForumID = fp.ForumID WHERE fp.ID = [PostID] AND (fp.VisibilityBand = N'Shared' OR (fp.VisibilityBand = N'Team' AND fa.CanSeeTeam = 1)))
